title: Strangers, without the two lives (arms C and S)
about: The strangers trial with the six residents dc2ecfc8 redrafted (the Quill and Morrow households and Kenji Sato) taken from the seed before it (`world.residents_from`, dc2ecfc8^), so that these arms differ from the lives arms only in the lives; every other resident is byte-identical in both.
